title: A Summit for the Current
author: Sable Dunmore
blurb: Lior Sandoval, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
